Title: Login with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Enter valid demo credentials; 2. Click Login

Title: Login with invalid password
Test Data: Valid demo username + deliberately incorrect password
Steps: 1. Enter username; 2. Enter incorrect password; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Access is denied and an error appears

Title: Add product to cart
Steps: 1. Click Add to cart; 2. Open cart

Title: Remove product from cart
Preconditions: Logged in with one item in cart

Title: Sort products by price low-to-high
Steps: 1. Open sort dropdown; 2. Select Price (low to high); 3. Compare prices

Title: Checkout with required fields empty
Preconditions: Logged in with item in cart
Steps: 1. Open cart; 2. Click Checkout; 3. Leave required fields empty; 4. Click Continue
Expected Result: Progress is blocked and validation feedback appears

Title: Complete checkout
Preconditions: Logged in with item in cart
Steps: 1. Open cart; 2. Checkout; 3. Fill required fields; 4. Continue; 5. Finish
